If every model set were below \(A^{(k)}\), that formula would uniformly enumerate the entire second-order part. This contradicts the source theorem on non-uniform-enumerability under the relevant reflection scheme. Finite tuples reduce to their join inside every omega-model of \(\mathsf{RCA}_0\). The proof correctly stays pointwise in standard k.
